role: Type constants and data structures for the semantic teaching pipeline.
detail: Defines node/edge type constants, step configuration dataclasses, and result types for SemanticTeachingHandler and the assert_fact ProceduralTemplate. The assert_fact template executes a six-step pipeline: validate_parse (verify syntactic bindings), call_pt10 (invoke LLM for semantic edge classification), check_contradiction (detect graph conflicts), create_edge (write semantic edge), update_scope_count (increment diversity count), and generate_response (produce PT-7 confirmation). Exports PT10Result (frozen dataclass with edge_type, confidence, property_type, clarification_needed, clarification_question, implicit_inferences_suppressed, model_tier, raw_response), ArbitrationRequest (conflict deferral node), SemanticTeachingResponse (PT-7 payload with success/edge_id/edge_type/subject_lemma/object_lemma/scope_context_count/property_type/implicit_inferences_suppressed/clarification fields), SemanticTeachingRequest (handler input with raw_text/template_name/role_bindings/node_ids/session_id), and SemanticPipelineState (mutable state carrier threading through six steps). Canonical semantic edge types are 16 constants (IS_A, HAS_PROPERTY, LACKS_PROPERTY, PART_OF, LOCATED_IN, USED_FOR, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, ACHIEVES, PRODUCES, CONSUMES, CONTRADICTS, SIMILAR_TO, OPPOSITE_OF); property_type subclassification for HAS_PROPERTY has three values: sensory, functional, categorical. Critical control-flow: scope_context_count only increments on genuine contextual diversity (different session or topic shift > 30 min), not same-session repetition, implementing Piagetian situated-to-categorical progression. Clarification threshold is confidence < 0.7. DENOTES edge type is excluded (cross-domain bridge written by language layer only).
constants: VALID_SEMANTIC_EDGE_TYPES={IS_A, HAS_PROPERTY, LACKS_PROPERTY, PART_OF, LOCATED_IN, USED_FOR, CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS, REQUIRES, ACHIEVES, PRODUCES, CONSUMES, CONTRADICTS, SIMILAR_TO, OPPOSITE_OF}
gotchas: None identified. Well-structured types with clear separation of concerns (PT-10 classification vs edge creation vs contradiction handling). All dataclasses frozen except SemanticPipelineState which is mutable state carrier. Clarification threshold hardcoded as < 0.7 in docstring.
